name: uri-port-in-san-ignored-valid
description: URI name constraints apply to the host part of the URI. The permitted URI subtree is host.example.com and the leaf URI SAN uses the same host with an explicit non-default port, so the port must be ignored for constraint matching and the chain is valid.
notes: This complements uri-constraint-with-port-invalid, which rejects a port on the constraint side. A common parser shortcut is to compare the full authority or host:port substring instead of extracting only the host from the SAN URI; that shortcut falsely rejects this leaf.
